Benjamin_1: twelfth-born son of Jacob and Rachel (Genesis 35:18)
Samuel_2: son of Elkanah and Hannah (1 Samuel 1:20)
Kish_1: a mighty man of valor [perhaps wealth or influence] (1 Samuel 9:1)
Abiel_1: (grand?)father of Kish (1 Samuel 9:1), (great?) grandfather of King Saul
Zeror_1: father of Abiel (1 Samuel 9:1), ancestor of King Saul
Becorath_1: father of Zeror (1 Samuel 9:1), ancestor of King Saul
Aphiah_1: father of Becorath (1 Samuel 9:1), ancestor of King Saul
Saul_1: son of Kish (1 Samuel 9:2), King of Israel (1 Samuel 11:15)
